I did not list them in tool_runs because they produced no evidence. Any future coverage.read run would measure line and toggle coverage on design files only, so the functional closure claim rests on the held-out testbench reading planned and holes. 'Independent review recorded' needs a new review_record for this artifact. [evidence:prj-fd79cfafd7.plan-audit.e1] covers the plan-audit matrix, not this model. There are no exclusions, so there is nothing to waive-review. Reviewers should check one interpretation: reset is ignored for the cross and occupancy bins, which are sampled only with rst_n high, and the reset bin needs rst_n low with count non-zero before the edge.
